answers.title: What each reviewer will ask.
answers.why: One line per question, with its status today.
answers.security: Where do prompts and files go?
To your gateway and the addresses your header allows, nowhere else: the browser enforces it.
Each person’s work, sealed with AES-256-GCM, behind a passkey or password lock your policy can require.
Has it been tested from outside?
The brief for the test is published. The test isn’t done yet.
answers.third: Is Warehouse SAS an ICT third-party provider?
Of a licence and its support only. It hosts and processes nothing of yours.
Neither: they audit a provider’s servers, and nothing of yours passes through ours. The trust pack answers for the code you deploy.
A contractual annex for DORA’s Article 30?
Not yet. Ask, and we write it with your clauses.
answers.data: Can the AI read client names and IBANs?
Not those you hide. Card numbers, IBANs and your own patterns are found on the computer; names leave as marks and come back in the answer.
Can confidential work stay on our own servers?
Yes. What your labels mark goes only to the AI your policy names for it, on premises if you wish.
Only by the AI your policy places in the countries it lists, and each answer’s certificate says where.
answers.records: In your OpenTelemetry collector: which AI, which tool, what was decided, with or without content, in a chain that shows tampering.
Can we keep records for a set time?
What people delete stays on their computer for the period you set, six months for the AI Act, with its certificates.
Sending, sharing and deleting ask first. Passwords and payments, never.

faq.title: Questions
faq.items: Can it sit beside Microsoft 365 Copilot?
Yes. It serves the people without a Copilot licence, on any computer with a browser, and reads and writes Microsoft 365 through your own app registration.
Does it run on virtual desktops?
It hasn’t been tried on Citrix or Azure Virtual Desktop yet. In Chrome and Edge, each person’s work can be mirrored to a folder on a network share, which they pick again after a desktop resets.
Where do our records live, for MiFID II, the SEC or FINRA?
Outside {name}: your gateway’s log and your collector, with content on, hold each request and answer, and your archive takes them from there.
